Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-03

1. PatchScout: Thematic Web Data Collection via Information Foraging
Researchers unveiled PatchScout, a system that assembles documents sharing a common theme from heterogeneous, disconnected regions of the web using an information‑foraging approach.

2. Taurus: LLM-in-the-Loop CT Annotation Matches Coding Agents at Half the Cost
Researchers built "Taurus," an LLM‑driven agent that either writes its own segmentation script from scratch or works inside a scripted harness that auto‑labels scans and then has the model verify the results. In both setups, the LLM achieved segmentation quality on par with specialized coding agents.

3. Dependence-Aware Risk Assessment and Optimal Design of AI-Agent Safeguard Systems
A team introduced a novel framework that models the interdependence of safeguard decisions in AI‑agent systems, enabling joint configuration and operational planning.
